about: The fontdant role list. Single source of truth: the CSS (dist/fontdant.css), the JS token object (dist/type-tokens.js), the checks and the panel all read from this file. Add a role, step, variant, mode or contract here and nowhere else.

groups.core: Always present. Every fontdant page uses these.
groups.data: Optional. Big tabular numerals on dashboards, gauges and KPI tiles.

faces.about: The three standard face slots. Each carries the fit target its aliases are normalised to (proposal §5, regime B): the build emits one @font-face alias per font × slot with size-adjust = target ÷ (font metric ÷ UPM). Targets are Inter's own ratios (measured), so the default look renders at 100%. The default look itself lives in fonts/library-source.json.

display.label: Display face
display.use: Hero lines, wordmarks, the two large heading steps.

text.label: Text face
text.use: Reading text, UI, captions, eyebrows, small headings.

mono.label: Mono face
mono.use: Code, terminal output, identifiers, lowercase eyebrows.

weights.about: Five weight dials. 600 is the house bold, 800 the display weight (repo audit §6).

dense.label: Dense
dense.use: Tools, consoles, admin. a dense console's ladder 12/13/14/15/16; body holds at 14px (F1).

reading.label: Reading
reading.use: Sites, docs, long form. Typical site ladders; fluid only for h-xl and display.

features.about: Boolean flags any role, step or variant may set.

roles.name: heading
roles.label: Heading
roles.use: Section, card and dialog headings. Steps xl lg md sm; the embedded scope compresses them inside messages and cards.

roles.name: body
roles.label: Body
roles.use: Reading text, chat messages, lists; table cells use body-sm with tnum. Never below 14px, even in dense (F1).

roles.name: ui
roles.label: UI
roles.use: Buttons, labels, inputs, nav, tabs, badges, the composer. One role; variants button, nav, input (F2).

roles.name: caption
roles.label: Caption
roles.use: Meta, hints, timestamps, status lines, source chips, fine print. Usually in frosting's muted colour.

roles.name: eyebrow
roles.label: Eyebrow
roles.use: Kicker above a heading, table header, section label, chip text. Variants upper (default) and lower (mono, lowercase).

roles.name: mono
roles.label: Mono
roles.use: Code inline and block, terminal output, diffs, identifiers. Steps block (default) and inline (em, relative to the surrounding text).

roles.name: metric
roles.label: Metric
roles.use: Big tabular numerals: gauges, KPI tiles, progress amounts, deck numerals. Any step from lg to display.

contracts.label: Relative units
contracts.rule: every size is rem or em, or clamp() containing a rem term

contracts.label: Unitless leading, em spacing
contracts.rule: leading is a unitless number; tracking is in em

contracts.label: Floors
contracts.source: Q4, F1; Apple HIG 11pt; console floor (12)
contracts.rule: per-mode floors in modes.*.floors, checked at the minimum scaling

contracts.label: Order
contracts.rule: steps strictly increasing within a mode

contracts.label: Weight floor
contracts.rule: weight < 400 below 24px warns; weight < 300 below 24px is hard

contracts.label: Swap normalisation
contracts.rule: face change with x-height ratio delta > 10% requires a fit target

contracts.label: Mono matches body
contracts.rule: adjusted x-heights of mono and body within 5%

contracts.label: Rendered survival
contracts.rule: survives the 1.4.12 overrides and reflows at 320px; zoom never blocked

contracts.label: Weight availability
contracts.rule: the role's weight exists in the face; never synthesised

contracts.label: Paragraph spacing
contracts.rule: body paragraph space >= 1.5 x leading (derived, always holds)

contracts.label: Body styling
contracts.rule: body is not justified, not italic, not uppercase by default
